text:
Noah Rivera: Running through the new next-samplekit + LlamaIndex tutorial. Followed README, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, but after deployment ISR pages randomly return 401s. JS starter doesn't auto-retry on auth rotation. Anyone seen this? cc @Yara

Yara Singh: Is this a project key or a short-lived session token? If it's rotation we should see x-rw-exp header on responses.

Noah Rivera: Project key but infra rotates keys for staging. Example handler used in sample: 
```js
// pages/api/ask.js
import { createRedwoodClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'
const client = createRedwoodClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/mini', prompt: req.body.q })
  res.json(r)
}
```

Ben Cho: That pattern (module-scope client) will keep a stale key across invocations in some serverless environments. The Python SDK added a refresh-on-rotation helper; JS hasn't. Workaround: instantiate client inside handler or catch 401+ x-rw-exp and retry once.

Noah Rivera: Logs: 
```
2026-03-10T11:22:01Z WARN upstream 401 x-rw-error=invalid_api_key x-rw-exp=170
2026-03-10T11:22:01Z ERROR unhandled -> 500
```

Yara Singh: OK that confirms rotation header. Ben, can you prototype a small change: if response is 401 and x-rw-exp present and <= now+20s then recreate auth and retry once? Keep retry limited to avoid loops.

Ben Cho: I'll sketch a PR. Also adding an e2e that simulates short-lived keys and a Next smoke test to devex CI to catch this class of issues.

DX Research: Suggest updating the starter README with a note about serverless instantiation best-practices and a short snippet for getServerSideProps that creates the client per-request until JS SDK ships the refresh logic.

Build Bot: CI run triggered: workflow/devex-next-smoke (branch fix/sdk-rotation) :gear: 1/1

Ben Cho: Draft PR visible here: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/834. Includes unit + e2e sim and README tweak.

Yara Singh: Assigning issue DX-2029 to Ben+Noah for fix + docs. I'll flip telemetry for the sample in staging so we can measure impact.

Noah Rivera: Verified staging after the merge — ISR pages stable, no 401s during key rotation. Thanks! :raised_hands:
